item.title: Weiser played their hearts out
item.description: Brayden Nordgren takes a three point shot early in the game against Cole Valley. Ryker Enders (20) and Zayn Crossley (24) are ready to move in for the rebound. Photo by Nancy Grindstaff Cole Valley came calling on Tuesday, Jan. 20. The contests began with a drawn out, thrilling frosh/soph game that came down to the end with Weiser holding on to the victory 52-49. The JV game was more pedestrian like with Weiser also winning that game 57-33. Free throw shooting in the JV game was nearly perfect.

item.title: Wolverines battle Homedale to narrow loss
item.description: Saturday, Jan. 17, the Weiser Wolverines traveled to Homedale. Three tight games were on tap for the boys. The frosh/soph game not only went the distance, it went way beyond with two, count them, two overtimes. Unfortunately, Weiser would lose 47-45. The JV came down to the wire as well with Weiser hanging on for dear life to win that contest 38-33. The varsity game was also a thriller but not the outcome Weiser was hoping for. item.description: Weiser’s Wolverine grapplers put on a good show in the home gym in a dual match with Homedale and Parma. item.title: 72nd Ground Hog Feed set to go
item.description: The Weiser Community Church annual Ground Hog Feed is set for Monday, Feb. 2. Come and enjoy a delicious meal and support a good cause. Proceeds will be donated to the Weiser Activity Center for Seniors. Plans for the Weiser Community Church’s 72nd Ground Hog Feed have been underway for months, and with 150 pounds of donated potatoes waiting to be peeled this Sunday, the community is invited to enjoy a favorite mid winter comfort meal. item.title: Weiser Lions Club leads February pantry refill drive
item.description: Giving From Your Heart, a Weiser Lions Club two-week food drive will help refill food pantries at Love INC and ROSE Advocates. Pictured are Weiser Lions Club members Linda Youngblood, Jonna Duvall-Williams, and Betty Simpson. Food pantry shelves don’t restock themselves, and the early winter donations that have carried many families through the holidays are nearly gone. That’s why the Weiser Lions Club and WHS Leos Club is launching a two week food drive in February to support Love INC and ROSE
